landcover_source: Impact Observatory / Esri / Microsoft; community-hosted Earth Engine mirror
climate_support: ERA5 native coarse grid sampled across DEM elevation bins; not fine-resolution downscaling
runoff_interpretation: Local ERA5 runoff generated by elevation, summed from high to low. Not routed flow or measured discharge by elevation.
dem_note: Copernicus and SRTM difference is inter-product spread, not error against ground control. No verified open sub-30 m DEM was identified for this basin.
